name: Mitsuryouku 2
source:
Daniel Lambert is a mercenary of Spranell Kingdom. His troops currently carry out occupation of the Oak grain village in the enemy Republic of Bali. By a twist of fate this village is Daniel's birthplace. What's the purpose of occupying the village that only has women and children left? Everything depends on Daniel's actions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
丹尼尔·兰伯特是斯普拉内尔王国的雇佣兵。他的部队目前正在占领敌对的巴厘共和国橡谷村。命运弄人，这座村庄正是丹尼尔的出生地。占领一座只剩妇女和儿童的村庄，究竟有何目的？一切都取决于丹尼尔的行动。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-the-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
